newsitem.title: USA: NY/NJ agency mulls Conrail/CSX intervention.
newsitem.headline: NY/NJ agency mulls Conrail/CSX intervention.

text.p: A committee of the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey is weighing whether to authorize the agency's executive director and general counsel to intervene in regulatory hearings on CSX Corp's proposed acquisition of Conrail Inc.
According to the committee's calendar for Thursday's meeting, it is discussing whether to authorize intervention in proceedings before the federal Surface Transportation Board.

The committee wants to ensure the New York metropolitan region's potential growth in rail service would not be limited by the lack of competitive long-haul service and Conrail's lack of direct routes to other markets, the document said.
It noted the acquisition of Conrail by either CSX or Norfolk Southern Corp might improve the region's access to what it called "hinterland markets."
However, "unless the federally sanctioned merger plan creates direct access by a competing Class I railroad to the region and local port authorities, the benefits may prove minimal."
Conrail has an agreement to be acquired by CSX, but Norfolk Southern continues to try to acquire Conrail.
